verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a well-documented, verified public Developer API (OpenAPI spec with 174 paths, confirmed live via probe), OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes, webhooks, a sandbox environment, and extensive machine-readable docs (llms.txt family) explicitly built for AI-agent consumption, alongside an official CLI and MCP servers exposing the same API surface. Both docs and live probes corroborate the API is real, functional, and agent-oriented.
